about.en: COINDEPO is the native token of CoinDepo, a crypto deposit and yield platform launched in 2021 that offers interest-bearing savings accounts and crypto-backed credit. Holding the token gives users boosted interest rates and other benefits on the platform. It is an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0xb40725714fe8c547c5b0c1472cba3554efa81718.
